mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification ( user_id, original_name, mime_type, file_size, object_key, public_url, verdict, score, api_provider, api_raw ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{originalName}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{objectKey}, #{publicUrl}, #{verdict}, #{score}, #{apiProvider}, #{apiRaw} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, original_name AS originalName, mime_type AS mimeType, file_size AS fileSize, object_key AS objectKey, public_url AS publicUrl, verdict, score, api_provider AS apiProvider, api_raw AS apiRaw, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt FROM verification WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, original_name AS originalName, mime_type AS mimeType, file_size AS fileSize, object_key AS objectKey, public_url AS publicUrl, verdict, score, api_provider AS apiProvider, api_raw AS apiRaw, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt FROM verification WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
